Maria: Heads-up: AltaHealth QBR scheduled next Tue. We saw a big embedding spike last Thurs, need a rapid cost-mitigation plan + HTAs for the meeting.
TJ: Confirmed. Billing alert fired — embeddings ~3.2x normal. Nightly reindex job ate tokens.
Sarah: Theyare on a small retainer with overage protection but theywant concrete options before renewal. Renewal risk if this continues.
Leo: I can run an enablement session on batching + caching. Quick: which embed model?
TJ: open-embed-2048, yes. Double-check: duplicates and full reindexes each night.
Maria: Short list for QBR: immediate guards (caps/alerts), ops fixes (batching, changed-since), model swaps, renewal offer.
CostBot: Billing alert: account/altahealth reached 82% of monthly credits at 2026-03-08T04:12:01Z.
Sarah: Short-term ask: soft token cap + email alert at 90%. Can we throttle nightly run to 30% while we sort?
TJ: We can set `billing.token_cap = 120000000` and add webhook to CS on 90%. Also can block non-critical reindex runs.
Leo: Immediate savings: enable prefix/KV caching and test quantized embedding `open-embed-2048-q8` (roughly 3x cheaper). I'll run A/B quality checks.
Maria: Add a note about regression risk with quantized vectors for transparency.
TJ: I'll post a 7-day forecast (current run-rate) with conservative x1.2 and aggressive x1.6 scenarios by EOD.
Sarah: I'll draft renewal slide with recommended mitigations and an optional 6mo retainer incentive.
Leo: I'll own the walkthrough: 45m (15m theory, 20m ops + scripts, 10m Q&A).
CostBot: Job note: scheduled job 'alta-reindex' ran 03/07 02:00 UTC and consumed ~18,000,000 tokens. Suggest `--changed-since` filter.
TJ: Reaching out to their eng (cc Jules) to suggest `--changed-since` and `--batch-size=500` — should cut nightly cost ~60%.
Sarah: Can finance approve a one-time credits buffer if they sign 6mo? Want to include option in deck.
Maria: Tentative: 10% credits bonus on 6mo commit, subject to finance ok. I'll include as conditional.
Leo: Ops checklist to include in the QBR: current run-rate + 7d forecast, token cap + alerts, embedding alternatives (cost/quality), reindex best-practices (changed-since, dedupe, batch), enablement slide + demo, renewal options (retainer tiers + credit bonus).
Maria: Owners: TJ = forecast & alert config; Leo = enablement doc + model test; Sarah = renewal slide + risk statement; Maria = runbook + agenda.
TJ: Will post forecast numbers here by 6pm PT.
Sarah: Scheduling QBR Tue 10am PT; enablement Thu 11am PT (tentative).
Maria: Keep notes in-thread so we can snapshot for the QBR. :thumbsup:
Leo: Quick ops snippet: `curl -X POST /v1/admin/accounts/altahealth/config -d '{"billing":{"token_cap":120000000}}'`
CostBot: Reminder: next billing cycle starts 2026-03-15.
Maria: Thanks team. Follow-ups in this thread.
